notes: Initial cross-machine trials failed because SSH forwarding backlog=5 refused simultaneous TCP connections; backlog is now 256. Raw failures retained outside successful aggregates.

Initial transaction run had one unaccepted request and exceeded the original 60s k6 teardown window; no final JSON was produced. Failure diagnosis unavailable for that initial response; later diagnostics are retained only in ignored local logs.

Serial TX trial r1 completed 500/500 with audit consistency in 81.462s; r2 interrupted during diagnosis. Old scanner visited one hash page per 15s, making recovery sensitive to historical ledger size. Recovery now visits up to 16 pages within a 12s job, preserving durable evidence and idempotent re-publication.
Interrupted extended trial and serial r2 were not counted as successful; no inference of server data loss from the harness interruption.

Earlier successful same-machine normal trials are retained here; selected main normal aggregates use the final image and -final test IDs. Other selected groups remain their original measured rounds; shared persisted state and different phase timing are documented limitations.
